message: 凪の如き薙刀を持つ巫女

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Demon Lord, what're we doin' at a shrine again?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, this is one of the spots where you can look out over the whole town. With KiraFes coming up this weekend, I wanted to see what kind of atmosphere Ryuusei Town has right now.」

name: Synn
message: 「I figured there's a certain vibe you can only pick up from a little ways outside the town center.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa, is Hisu rubbing off on ya? You're soundin' kinda poetic there.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoops, my bad. Hehehe... Your real goal is keepin' tabs on Flatty and Forehead, ain't it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「From up high like this, you can see clear as day whether that big lug's actually doin' his sandwich-board job.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not letting your guard down even around your own kind, and watching 'em on the sly from where you won't get spotted--that's Synn-sama for ya.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Shio-chan.」
I walk up to Shio-chan, who isn't reacting.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Synn-sama, one more half-step and you're right inside that naginata girl's striking range, ya know?」

name: Shio
message: 「How troublesome. I was testing my mind's eye, and having you give play-by-play commentary ruins the whole point.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Shio-chan. Sorry for interrupting you.」

name: Shio
message: 「No, no, I was speaking to that spirit over there. Pay it no mind, Synn-dono.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, so it's just me, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「So today you're on shrine maiden duty instead of the Naginata Club.」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, this is club activity!」
An autumn breeze blows through, and a few eager leaves are already fluttering down.
The instant one of the fluttering leaves touches the blade of her naginata, it is sliced cleanly in two.
Shio-chan hasn't moved a muscle.

name: Shio
message: 「It is like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's insanely sharp.」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. For I sharpened it in preparation for KiraFes.」

name: Shio
message: 「In addition to our demonstration performance, the Naginata Club also plans to operate as knife sharpeners and take in everyone's household kitchen knives.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, so you were maintaining your beloved blade as practice, too.」

name: Shio
message: 「Precisely!」
The blade shines even brighter than usual.
And it isn't a blinding, glaring light that dazzles the eyes, either--it softly reflects the sun.

name: Synn
message: 「It's a nice naginata.」
Even though I don't know anything at all about weapons, I end up muttering that completely naturally.

name: Shio
message: 「If it pleases you, please take it in hand.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is it okay? For me to hold it?」

name: Shio
message: 「A fine tool chooses its master.」

name: Shio
message: 「If gazing upon the Asukai naginata has struck a chord with you, that means Synn-dono is worthy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on a second. Talk about overestimating me. I have no idea how to handle a naginata.」

name: Synn
message: 「At most, I only swung around a duster broom when I was a kid, I tell you.」

name: Shio
message: 「That is more than enough.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I wonder if this is really okay...」
I receive the naginata from Shio-chan.
It's surprisingly light.
...Actually, isn't it too light? It feels no heavier than a feather.
Another falling leaf.
Just like before, a fluttering leaf drifts toward the naginata's blade--
It doesn't touch it.
The leaf flutters away as if avoiding the blade, falling straight onto the shrine grounds.

name: Shio
message: 「I have lost.」

name: Shio
message: 「I was defeated by Synn-dono just now. I must train even harder.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah. Well then, I'll give your naginata back.」

name: Shio
message: 「The Asukai naginata must serve as a good omen in times of ill fortune.」

name: Shio
message: 「One's weapon is an extension of one's own body. Needless slicing of fallen leaves is a bad omen. Proof that I am still immature.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! Now a dragonfly landed on the blade.」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, it has long tails growing from it. This is a mayfly, indeed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that right? It's been so long since I've seen one, I couldn't tell the difference.」

name: Shio
message: 「Then please continue to visit the shrine in the future. The sacred grove is a treasure trove of living creatures.」

name: Shio
message: 「However, a mayfly at the beginning of autumn like this--how very unusual...」
Though a cold, strong wind blows, the mayfly remains perched on the sharp tip of the naginata, refusing to budge.

name: Shio
message: 「Now then, that is enough resting for you.」

name: Shio
message: 「Today is a precious break in the autumn rains. If it turns cold and the waters freeze, you will not be able to lay your eggs, you know?」
Shio-chan gently reasons with it, standing completely motionless without letting the naginata waver.
The mayfly flutters lightly into flight, heading into the forest.

name: Shio
message: 「It has grown rather chilly. I shall go brew some hot tea. Please wait a moment.」
Just like that, we drink tea in the shrine precincts....

name: Shio
message: 「It was a fine visit.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, thanks for the great tea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I somehow missed my chance to say it.」
Walking down the steps of the shrine approach, I speak to Paqy.

name: Paqy
message: 「Say what?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though she ended up cutting a leaf, having a mayfly land and rest on the blade is way more amazing, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Though Shio-chan doesn't seem aware of it at all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「When something comes too naturally, you end up not noticing it yourself.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, ain't it best to just watch over her without blabbing unnecessary stuff?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That naginata girl's got talent. Though for now, all she's got is raw potential.」

name: Synn
message: 「Which means if an outsider carelessly butts in, I might end up crushing that budding talent.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, let's just watch over them quietly.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You do that. For the sake of good tea, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, so that's what you're after, Paqy.」
